user.title: Sign in to Tile
user.description: Credentials are used once to download tracker keys; the password is not stored. Afterwards the integration works locally, without the cloud.

data_description.battery_enabled: Requires storing Tile credentials and a once-per-24h cloud check - the only part of this integration that is not fully local.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Tile again
reauth_confirm.description: The stored Tile credentials for {email} were rejected. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Tile cloud
error.no_tiles: No trackers with a key found in the account

report_advertisement.name: Report advertisement
report_advertisement.description: Feed a Tile 0xFEED advertisement captured outside Home Assistant (e.g. by a Linux machine). The tracker is identified by its privateId and its entities are updated as if HA had heard it.

service_data.name: Service data
service_data.description: Hex of the 0xFEED service data, e.g. 02005034270c2859af20.

address.name: Address
address.description: BLE MAC address of the advertisement.

source.name: Source
source.description: Name of the scanner that captured it (shown in the presence sensor's source attribute).

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Static zone where the scanner is located (default zone.home). The tracker's device_tracker moves to this zone.
